caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Methods identify P1369 as methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative Staphylococcus, while some DBAASP/dbAMP rows label it Staphylococcus aureus.
APD6 AP04543 aggregates source-supported Kn2-7 rows but its HC50 wording conflicts with the primary Figure 1D/Results HC50 value; not normalized away.
dbAMP rows contain source-supported 2012 MIC subsets plus unsupported/cross-paper target and cell-line values; unsupported tails remain source_conflict.
Figure 1A/C/D and Figures 4-7 were used only for source-supported sequence/screening/hemolysis/mechanism context; exact graph-only bar or curve point values were not invented.
Local supplementary files are HTML/image captures with no parsed spreadsheet or table; they did not change activity/toxicity/mechanism/database conclusions.

supplementary_assets.note: Local landed supplementary assets are HTML/image captures and no structured supplementary table was recoverable or needed after XML/PDF/Figure 1 review.

per_layer_decision_rationale.final_decision: The previous full_source_review_not_completed and database_conflicts_require_adjudication blockers are closed; acceptance is with cautions, not clean acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP row-level MIC and HC50 records were rematched to primary Tables 1-2 and Figure 1D; P1369 organism-label conflict, APD6 HC50 conflict, and dbAMP aggregated cross-paper tails remain source_conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Existing Table 1/2 MIC rows were retained with target classes corrected for clinical bacterial isolates, and HC50 hemolysis rows were added from primary Figure 1D/Results text.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Framework pending mechanism placeholders were replaced with bounded source-reviewed CD, enzyme-release/time-kill/TEM, and BLI/LTA-LPS competition claims without fabricating graph-only values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: Local supplementary assets were typed and indexed; no structured supplementary table or spreadsheet was recoverable, and this is nonblocking because XML/PDF/OA/database evidence resolves the owner-layer ticket.
